# stripe_metronome_billable_metric (Resource)

COUNT or SUM billable metric filtered to one event type. Destroy archives the metric.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_type` (String) Event type matched by this metric.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `aggregation_key` (String) Event property to sum when aggregation_type is SUM. The provider requires this property to exist on matched events.
- `aggregation_type` (String) COUNT events or SUM a numeric event property.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
